sections.name: architecture
sections.value: Doctrine: .agents/skills/pij-team/TENETS.md. Two halves. (A) Rust installer: extend crates/harnesses/src/claude_settings.rs (plan 126, on main after PR merge — REBASE onto origin/main first and read that module; reuse its home discovery, backup, additive-JSON write, report struct, spine event). Add `ensure_claude_session_start_hook(homes, script_path)`: settings.json `hooks.SessionStart` gets one entry `{matcher:"", hooks:[{type:"command", command:"<abs path to script>"}]}` if no entry with that command exists. Call it where 126 calls the accept ensure (crates/cli/src/main.rs run_daemon + registration hook is NOT needed for the hook — boot only). Doctor verb `doctor claude-hook`. (B) The hook script: harness/scripts/claude-session-start-pij.sh (POSIX sh, <40 lines): `[ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ] || exit 0`; `pij-rs ping >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0`; `pij adopt "$TMUX_PANE" --harness claude >>~/.pij-rs/hook.log 2>&1 || true`; exit 0. Read Claude Code's hook contract for SessionStart (stdin JSON with session_id, cwd; stdout may be shown) — keep stdout empty. The absolute script path is resolved by the daemon from its own binary/repo location or a configured path; document which. rs adopt idempotence: crates/daemon/src/http/identity.rs:466-480.

value.rationale: One Rust function mirroring plan 126, one sh script, one doctor verb, live proofs. PM codes, then Claude opus reviewer.

value.name: session-start adopt hook + installer
value.paths: harness/scripts/claude-session-start-pij.sh (new), crates/harnesses/src/claude_settings.rs (+tests), crates/cli/src/main.rs (boot call + doctor verb), docs/how/claude-auto-seat.md (new, short)
value.responsibility: Every Claude home gets a SessionStart hook that adopts the pane into rs once per session; statusline untouched except the TMUX_PANE guard note.
value.interface: pub fn ensure_claude_session_start_hook(homes: &[PathBuf], script: &Path) -> Vec<EnsureReport> (same EnsureReport as 126); spine event kind `config.claude-hook-ensured` on change only.
value.test_strategy: cargo test -p pij-harnesses: absent hooks → added; existing other hooks preserved byte-for-byte; already present → no-op; malformed → refused. Script: a shell test with TMUX_PANE unset → exit 0 no output. RED-first.
value.note: Never remove or reorder existing hook entries. Backups as in 126.

value.mode: solo-pm in the plan worktree (~/pi-hacking/fs3-claude-session-start-adopt, branch 127-claude-session-start-adopt) — rebase onto origin/main after plan 126 (#347 or later) merges; ask prime if unsure whether it has
value.note: Default: each coder gets its own worktree, branching off the PM's plan branch; unit lands back onto the plan branch (PM merges — coders never merge). Shared-tree work is the retro-proven #1 hazard (staged sweeps, untrustworthy greens) — only choose it for trivially disjoint single-wave work, and then file-scoped `git add` only, never -A. REMEMBER: fences partition WRITE intent, not the build — a mid-refactor sibling can still break your compile, so waves must respect build dependencies, and a broken workspace build is a PM composition concern, not a coder's to fix cross-fence.

value.steps: Rebase; build; cargo test; harness checks (symlink canonical node_modules in a fresh worktree); live AC1-AC3 against an ISOLATED daemon (never restart production) with the hook pointed at the branch script; restore operator settings if you touched the real ones.

value.when: after composition (or after solo-pm coding), before the PR into main
value.inputs: plan.dd.md + this impl-guide + full branch diff; priority = plan promises, composition seams, interface drift, correctness, contract-test gaps

value.text: Hook stdout is shown to the user by Claude in some versions — keep stdout empty, log to file.
Script path baked into settings.json goes stale if the repo moves — prefer a stable path (~/.npm-global/bin or a `pij-rs hook session-start` verb) and record the choice.
Adopt before the daemon has stamped consent (s121 does it at registration, fine) — verify AC1 shows accept=true.
